name: is-it-done-yet-mod
description: A Claude Code mod: a docked progress pane that finds your project's plan or progress notes among its markdown files (or uses the agent's task list) and shows percent done, phases, tasks, time, tokens and API cost.

plugins.name: is-it-done-yet
plugins.description: A progress pane beside the Claude Code terminal for big, multi-phase work. Open it in any existing project: it looks through the folder's markdown files, finds the plan, checklist or progress note by reading what they say (no file names built in), or uses the agent's task list, then shows overall percent, an accordion of phases and tasks with green/blue/grey bars, elapsed time, a rough ETA, total tokens and the API-equivalent cost. Adds nothing to the model's context. Reach L1: reads the project's markdown files and the transcript's task calls; no processes, environment variables or network.
